text: A user session first, then an administrator's on top of it. A user can do what one member of staff can; an administrator can change the whole server. One weakness led to the next. Fixing either one breaks the chain.
style: Security lead on Merrin & Sallow's outsourced IT provider (Fenlow Managed IT), in her 40s, warm and practical. Speak with a consistent London and southern English accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent.
